newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf sees Leuna refinery running in October.
newsitem.headline: Elf sees Leuna refinery running in October.

text.p: Elf Aquitaine chairman Philippe Jaffre said on Friday that work on the Leuna refinery in eastern Germany was nearly complete and it was expected to be in production in October.
"If everything goes as planned, the first products should come out in October," he told the shareholders meeting.
A judicial investigation is under way into payments allegedly paid by Elf, under a previous management, between 1989 and 1993 in connection with the 1992 purchase of Leuna.
Jaffre noted that Elf brought a civil suit in 1995, a year after the French judicial probe began.

"We shouldn't lose sight of the fact that the events took place more than five years ago and have nothing to do with the company of today," he said. He added that he expected the investigation to take a long time.
He said Elf believes its investment in Germany will be profitable.
